item.title: Renpho scale, Home Assistant, reverse-engineering the API, and a weight forecast
item.description: I wanted scale readings in Home Assistant next to the rest of my apartment automations — not another siloed health app. That turned into maintaining hass_renpho[1] (a fork of the quiet community integration), running APKLeaks on the Android client, a Lovelace board I still open when training or sleep changes, and a notebook that tries to forecast weight from the exported history.
